item.title: Fijiana ready to give their all in Dubai 7s opener against Canada
item.description: The Fiji Airways Fijiana 7s team is determined to treat every match like a final as they prepare to face Canada in their opening pool match at the Dubai 7s today. Fijiana 7s captain Ana Naimasi says the players are ready to put what they have learnt during training into practice when they take the field.
item.content:encoded:
The Fiji Airways Fijiana 7s team is determined to treat every match like a final as they prepare to face Canada in their opening pool match at the Dubai 7s today.

Fijiana 7s captain Ana Naimasi says the players are ready to put what they have learnt during training into practice when they take the field.

Speaking after the team's captain's run in Dubai, Naimasi says they are aware that Canada will have several players making their debuts, but this will not change their approach to the match.

She says the team is focused on playing with the same intensity and determination they would bring to a final.

Naimasi says the players are eager to put their preparations into practice, not only against Canada but throughout their remaining pool matches.

She says the team will stick to its game plan and focus on enjoying its rugby without being distracted by outside opinions.

The Fijiana will open their Dubai 7s campaign against Canada at 6.44pm today.

They will then face Japan at 11.44pm before taking on New Zealand at 2.52am tomorrow.

Meanwhile, the Fiji Men's team will open their campaign against New Zealand at 8.36pm tonight.

They will then take on France at 11.17pm before facing Spain at 4am tomorrow in their final pool match.

The men's semi-finals will kick off at 10.06pm tomorrow, while the final is scheduled for 4.11am on Monday.

item.title: Fiji 7s focus on breakdown play and decision-making ahead of Dubai 7s
item.description: The Fiji Airways National Men's 7s team will be focusing on their breakdown play and decision-making at the Dubai 7s this weekend. Speaking from their camp in Dubai, coach Osea Kolinisau says they are also focusing on their defensive shape and one-on-one tackles.
item.content:encoded:
The Fiji Airways National Men's 7s team will be focusing on their breakdown play and decision-making at the Dubai 7s this weekend.

Speaking from their camp in Dubai, coach Osea Kolinisau says they are also focusing on their defensive shape and one-on-one tackles.

He says the team is familiarising itself with the new rules, including those relating to hip-drop tackles, and is holding awareness sessions.

Kolinisau says kick-offs are another area of focus, particularly ahead of their clash against New Zealand, who are expected to contest the breakdowns.

Fiji will open their campaign against New Zealand at 8.36pm tonight.

They will then take on France at 11.17pm before facing Spain at 4am tomorrow in their final pool match.

The men's semi-finals will kick off at 10.06pm tomorrow, while the final is scheduled for 4.11am on Monday.

Meanwhile, the Fijiana 7s side will meet Canada in their first pool match at 6.44pm tonight.

They will then take on Japan at 11.44pm before playing New Zealand at 2.52am tomorrow in their final pool match.

The women's semi-finals will begin at 9.12pm tomorrow, while the final is scheduled for 3.35am on Monday.
